decision_rules.note: These are resource/causal-screening heuristics, not significance tests.

natural_interventions.guard: These checkpoint differences are descriptive natural interventions, not randomized causal proof.

next_step.rationale: Raw high-IoU candidate absence dominates E10a top500 failures at IoU=0.75, and the TAL proxy shows a strong tiny/dense assignment scarcity or conflict signal. The next formal intervention should be P2/small-isolated assignment supervision, not another generic feature or score module.

hard_boundaries: Do not reinterpret max_det=1000 as the formal evaluation protocol.
TAL proxy is final-checkpoint/eval-output behavior, not logged training history.
Raw-geometry absence does not by itself prove backbone representation failure.
NMS-stage existence analysis is per-GT candidate existence, not COCO one-to-one matching.
Do not train a classification-only E22a unless D23 explicitly selects the classification branch.
If assignment is selected, keep the intervention P2/small isolated and preserve E10a inference topology.
